 Bank and Tower] I.e. the Bank of England and the Tower of London, the former the treasury and
centre of financial administration for the country, the latter a fortress, garrison, arsenal, depository for
the crown jewels and occasional state prison — institutional symbols of the gold and blood the soldiers
call for in l. Seizure of both was claimed by government witnesses at their respective trials to have
been the object of both the revolutionary conspiracy of Colonel Despard in 1802 and of the Spa Fields
